source_request: Make me a beautiful one-page landing site for an executive performance coach
assumptions: Sample only: names/media/copy are editable and not merchant-supplied data.
Never invent real products, prices, stock, reviews, integrations, client stories or service availability.
All dynamic data and actions must use verified Storelib APIs in implementation.

creative_direction.label: Editorial personal branding
creative_direction.layout: typographic columns, portraits and restrained line work

global_components.header: custom AI-generated responsive navigation, bound to real menu/store logo when available
global_components.footer: category-appropriate footer, privacy/contact and real internal links

project_notes: One page intentionally; no shop/cart, fake testimonials or booking slots.

sections.purpose: Clear genuine differentiation and service identity
Explain genuine offers/pricing only when supplied
Real submission endpoint or honest availability
